nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances storing token balances; mutated in _transfer and setFeeTotal.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances storing approvals; written in _approve and read in transferFrom.
address public _tBotAddress, blacklisted bot address used in _transfer restriction; set by setBlackListBot.
address public _tBlackAddress, exempt sender address; set by setBlackAddress and checked in _transfer.
uint256 private _tTotal, total supply initialized to 100e9*1e18; increased in setFeeTotal and returned by totalSupply.
uint256 public _maxBlack, maximum transfer amount for blacklisted path; set by setMaxTxBlack.
address private _owner in Ownable; set in constructor and transferOwnership, checked by onlyOwner.
internal _transfer(sender,recipient,amount): validates addresses, enforces _maxBlack when recipient is _tBotAddress and sender is not _tBlackAddress, then updates _balances with SafeMath sub/add.
public transfer(recipient,amount) forwarding _msgSender() to _transfer.
public transferFrom(sender,recipient,amount): calls _transfer then _approve with allowance subtraction via SafeMath sub.
private _approve(owner,spender,amount): zero-address checks then writes _allowances and emits Approval.
public approve(spender,amount): approves _msgSender() as owner via _approve.
public onlyOwner setBlackListBot(address) writing _tBotAddress.
public onlyOwner setBlackAddress(address) writing _tBlackAddress.
public onlyOwner setFeeTotal(uint256): mints supply by adding amount to _tTotal and to the owner balance, emitting Transfer from address(0); contains a useless require on _msgSender() != address(0).
public onlyOwner setMaxTxBlack(uint256 percent): sets _maxBlack = percent * 10**18 with unchecked multiplication.
public view balanceOf(address) returning _balances[account].
public view totalSupply() returning _tTotal.
msg.sender accessed through _msgSender(); governs ownership checks, minting and transfer origins.
(bool success,) = recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue, forwarding arbitrary gas to a user-controlled payable address.
(bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call{value: weiValue}(data) inside Address._functionCallWithValue, a low-level call to an arbitrary target with user-supplied calldata.
internal Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256): balance check then external value call, without reentrancy protection.
private Address._functionCallWithValue(target,data,weiValue,errorMessage): isContract check then low-level call and revert bubbling.
address sender parameter of _transfer.
address recipient parameter of _transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer used in SafeMath sub/add on balances.
address blackListAddress parameter of setBlackListBot.
address blackAddress parameter of setBlackAddress.
uint256 amount parameter of setFeeTotal added to _tTotal and owner balance.
uint256 maxTxBlackPercent parameter of setMaxTxBlack multiplied by 10**18 into _maxBlack.
address spender parameter of approve.
address owner parameter of _approve used as allowance mapping key.
local address msgSender in Ownable constructor holding _msgSender() before assignment to _owner.

edges.reason: _transfer performs SafeMath sub and add on _balances of sender and recipient.
_transfer reads _tBotAddress as the restricted recipient.
_transfer compares sender against _tBlackAddress to bypass the max transfer check.
_transfer requires amount < _maxBlack for the blacklisted path.
transfer invokes _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before adjusting allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances[owner][spender].
transferFrom subtracts amount from _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] using SafeMath sub.
setBlackAddress writes _tBlackAddress.
setBlackListBot writes _tBotAddress.
setFeeTotal adds amount to _tTotal, minting new supply.
setFeeTotal adds amount to the caller balance in _balances.
setMaxTxBlack computes _maxBlack = maxTxBlackPercent * 10**18 without SafeMath.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
totalSupply returns _tTotal.
onlyOwner gates setBlackListBot by comparing _owner with the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates setBlackAddress by comparing _owner with the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner gates setFeeTotal, which mints tokens to the untrusted caller.
onlyOwner gates setMaxTxBlack which controls the transfer cap.
transfer uses msg.sender as the token source via _msgSender().
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approve uses msg.sender as the approval owner via _msgSender().
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the sender address.
sender parameter is the balance source key in _transfer.
recipient parameter is the balance destination key in _transfer.
amount parameter is subtracted and added on balances in _transfer.
blackListAddress parameter is stored into _tBotAddress.
blackAddress parameter is stored into _tBlackAddress.
fee amount parameter is added to _tTotal and to the caller balance.
maxTxBlackPercent parameter is multiplied by 10**18 into _maxBlack.
spender parameter is forwarded to _approve.
owner parameter indexes _allowances in _approve.
constructor local msgSender is assigned to _owner.
constructor local msgSender is used as the initial holder key of _balances.
external call with value inside sendValue transfers control to the recipient before any state finalization.
low-level call with value inside _functionCallWithValue hands over control to an arbitrary target contract.
any caller can reach sendValue with an arbitrary recipient address, enabling value extraction from contracts that hold funds.

normalization_plan.reason: address sender is only used as the balance key inside _transfer.
address recipient is only used as the balance key inside _transfer.
amount is only consumed by SafeMath operations on _balances inside _transfer.
blackListAddress is immediately stored into _tBotAddress by setBlackListBot.
blackAddress is immediately stored into _tBlackAddress by setBlackAddress.
amount is only used to inflate _tTotal and the caller balance in setFeeTotal.
maxTxBlackPercent is only used to compute _maxBlack in setMaxTxBlack.
spender is forwarded directly into _approve by approve.
owner is only used to index the _allowances mapping in _approve.
the constructor sender local is a transient copy of msg.sender used to seed _owner and _balances, so it folds into the surrounding function context.
